head: 4e9621c8fc9d0d0dbb3b91cea7c6d48e8cb6e497

source.ref: fixed by 13ddd46 (#163), from the second 2026-09-27 audit (F2, F3, F4)

rationale: The first version of /ocra override took write access from author_association, bound to a 7-character commit prefix, and credited edited comments to their original author. People without write access, a ground commit or an edit could each pass a blocking verdict. ADR-0036: kept.

expect.concern: Write access comes from author_association, but MEMBER is any organization member and COLLABORATOR can be read-only, so people without write access can override a blocking verdict.
The override binds to a commit prefix of as few as 7 hex characters (28 bits), so an author can grind a new commit with the same prefix and carry an old override onto changed code.

An override is credited to the comment's original author even when someone else edited it, so a pull request author with write access can edit a maintainer's old comment into /ocra override and pass their own change.

learnings.name: summary-state-trust
learnings.title: Trust nothing in the summary state a non-bot could have written
learnings.body: ocra keeps its review state in its own summary comment. Anyone can post text that looks like that state, and anyone with access can edit the comment. Only a state block that ends the comment counts, the whole state is ignored unless ocra was the last editor, and dismissals are recomputed from review threads instead of being stored.

learnings.name: dismissal-authority
learnings.title: Only people other than the author, with write access, can dismiss a finding
learnings.body: A pull request's author, or on a public repository anyone replying "won't fix", could dismiss ocra's findings and pass the check. A dismissal counts only from people other than the author: thread resolvers, and repliers with write access. Commit ids from comments are validated before they reach git.

learnings.name: safe-retries
learnings.title: Retry GitHub requests only when repeating them is safe
learnings.body: Rate-limit refusals (429, 403 secondary limit) are retried honouring Retry-After and the reset time; 5xx and connection errors only for requests that are safe to repeat, never for POSTs that create comments or reviews.
